tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /skyes bu gsum dang bslab pa gsum dang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi dka' gnas legs par bshad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /skyes bu gsum dang bslab pa gsum dang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi dka' gnas legs par bshad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skyes bu gsum dang bslab pa gsum dang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi dka' gnas legs par bshad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/

thub dbang dam pa mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'dzam gling rgyan drug dpal ldan a ti sha/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras bcas pa la/ /snying nas 'dud do brtse ba'i lcags kyus gzung*/ /de la 'dir nye bar mkho ba'i dka' gnad 'ga' zhig mtha' dpyod kyi sgo nas brjod par bya ste/ 'di la gsum/ skyes bu gsum gyi 'jog tshul/ bslab pa gsum gyi khyad par/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi khyad par ro/ /dang po la gnyis/ gsung rab kyi don thams cad skyes bu gsum gyi lam nyams len gyi rim par 'du tshul dang skyes bu gsum gyi khyad par dang*/ lam de'i che ba bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyal bas chos ji snyed cig bstan pa thams cad kyang sems can gyi don du yin la/ sems can gyi don la gnyis te mngon mtho dang nges legs la 'god pa'o/ /de yang gnas skabs mngon mtho lha mi'i rten sgrub pa las brtsams te chos ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad ni skyes bu chung ngu dngos sam chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i chos skor du 'du ste/ /ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam tshul dang bde 'gro'i yon tan 'thob tshul tsam gtso bor ston pa'i mdo rnams der 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /nges legs la thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis yod pa'i dang po'i dbang du byas nas/ nyan rang gi theg pa las brtsams te chos ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad ni skyes bu 'bring dngos sam de dang thun mong ba'i chos skor du 'du ste/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang thar pa'i phan yon tsam gtso bor ston pa'i mdo rnams der 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa las brtsams te chos ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad ni skyes bu chen po'i chos skor du 'du ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs gtso bor ston pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung rnams ni der 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /ngan 'gro'i nyes dmigs dang bde 'gro'i yon tan gtso bor ston pa'i theg chen gyi mdo dang*/

'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang thar pa'i phan yon gtso bor ston pa'i theg chen gyi mdo'i cha 'ga' zhig la ni/ skyes bu chung 'bring dang thun mong ba'i skor zhes bya'i/ de dag dngos ni min te/ dper na/ mi rtag pa dang gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi lam 'ga' zhig rang ldog nas skyes bu chen po'i lam yin kyang skyes bu chung 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam du 'jog pa bzhin no/ /de la tshe 'di'i bde ba tsam don du gnyer ba'i skyes bu rnams ni spyir skyes bu chung ngu'am tha ma yin kyang*/ de skyes bu la gsum du phye ba'i chung ngu ni min te/ de la gsum du phye ba'i chung ngu ni tshe 'di'i bde ba tsam la gtso bor mi byed par phyi ma'i mngon mtho'i bde ba gtso bor don du gnyer ba zhig la byed pa'i phyir te/ lam sgron las/ gang zhig thabs ni gang dag gis/ /'khor ba'i bde ba tsam dag la/ /rang nyid don du gnyer byed pa/ /skyes bu de ni tha mar shes zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mngon mtho tsam don du gnyer ba la'ang gnyis te/ thabs nor ba la zhugs pa dang*/ ma nor ba la zhugs pa'o/ /'dir ni phyi ma yin gyi snga ma ni ma yin te/ yin na mngon mtho don du gnyer ba'i phyi rol pa'ang skyes bu der thal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na phyi ma'i mngon mtho tsam don gnyer gyi thabs ma nor bsgrub pa la gtso bor zhugs pa'i gang zag rnams ni skyes bu chung ngu dngos yin la/ mngon mtho don du gnyer ba'i theg chen pa yod kyang*/ /de dag gis skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam nyams su len pa yin gyi/ skyes bu chung ngu dngos ni min no/ /theg dman gyi rigs can rnams ni skyes bu che chung gnyis su phye ba'i chung ngu yin kyang skyes bu gsum du byas pa'i chung ngu ma yin gyi/ 'bring yin te/ de gsum du phye ba'i 'bring ni 'khor ba las grol ba'i thar pa tsam gtso bor don du gnyer ba zhig la byed pa'i phyir te/

lam skron las/ srid pa'i bde las rgyab phyogs shing*/ /sdig pa'i las las ldog bdag nyid/ /gang zhig rang zhi tsam don gnyer/ /skyes bu de ni 'bring zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ched du bya ba thar pa tsam gtso bo don du gnyer ba'i gang zag rnams ni skyes bu gsum du phye ba'i 'bring dngos yin kyang*/ thar pa don du gnyer ba'i theg chen gyi rigs can gyis ni/ skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam nyams su len pa yin gyi/ 'bring dngos ni ma yin no/ /skyes bu chen po ni/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i ched du rang nyid kyang sangs rgyas thob 'dod zhig la byed pa yin te/ lam sgron las/ rang rgyud gtogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun/ /yang dag zad par kun nas 'dod/ /skyes bu de ni mchog yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na thig chen pa yin na skyes bu chen po yin dgos pas/ de'i rgyud kyi lam yin na'ang skyes bu chen po'i lam yin dgos so/ /de'i rgyud kyi dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal sogs ngan 'gro'i nyes dmigs bsam pa'i lam de skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa sogs 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa'i lam de skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i laṃ yin gyi/ skyes bu chung 'bring gi lam dngos gnas pa ma yin no/ /rigs can gsum ka la lam ma zhugs yod kyang*/ theg pa gsum po gang rung la gnas pa'i gang zag yin na/ lam zhugs yin dgos pas de gang rung gi lam yin na'ang lam yin dgos la/ /skyes bu gsum po gang rung gi lam yin na lam dngos yin mi dgos te/ lam ma zhugs na de gsum dang de gsum gyi lam yod pa'i phyir te/ de na ngan 'gro dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal tshul bzhin du bsam pa dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa don du gnyer ba yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang*/

skyes bu gsum po gang rung gi lam la lam gyis ma khyab ste/ dper na/ ngan 'gro'i lam dang bde 'gro'i lam la lam gyis ma khyab pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ mi dge ba bcu ngan 'gro'i lam dang*/ dge ba bcu bde 'gro'i lam yin pa bzhin no/ /'o na rim pa de ltar 'khrid pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na yod de/ skyes bu chung 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam rnams skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi sngon 'gror shes pa'i tshe dang*/ blo rab 'bring tha gsum la phan pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ de yang byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i skabs su ni skyes bu chung 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam la 'khrid pa yin gyi/ de'i lam dngos la 'khrid pa ni ma yin te/ de dngos la 'khrid na ni byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi go sar ltung ba'i dgag bya yod pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na rang nyid ngan song las thar 'dod med na 'khor ba las thar 'dod mi 'byung la/ de ma byung na gzhan de dag las skyob 'dod mi 'byung bas/ gzhan don du rdzogs byang thob 'dod kyang mi 'ong la/ de 'ong ba la ni zlog phyogs snga ma snga ma sngon du 'gro dgos so/ /gom rim sngar bshad pa ltar sbyong dgos te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ dang por mngon par mtho ba'i chos/ /phyis ni nges par legs 'byung ba/ /zhes dang*/ 'phags pa lhas kyang*/ thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs/ zhes dang*/ bsod nams min pa dang por zlog /bar du bdag ni bzlog pa dang*/ /tha mar lta zhig kun bzlog pa/ /gang gis shes de mkhas pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rim gyis bkri ba'i gnad dam go rim yang de ltar du shes dgos so/ /gnyis pa che ba ni/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi don skyes bu gsum gyi lam nyams len gyi rim par 'du tshul legs par shes dgos shing shes na ni/ lam rim gyi che ba'am khyad chos bzhi po de rang nyid kyi kyang 'thob par 'gyur te/

lam rim bsdus don las/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang*/ /gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'chang ba dang*/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed pa dang*/ /nyes spyod chen po'i g.yang sa las kyang srung*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thob par 'gyur ba'i phyi ro/ /de yang sngar bshad pa ltar shes na ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab kha cig gis ni lam gyi gtso bo ston la/ kha cig gis ni lam gyi yan lag ston par shes nas de rnams dngos brgyud ci rigs kyi sgo nas 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du go bas na/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs pa de 'byung*/ /de byung na mdo sngags kyi gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pas kyang nyams len gyi gnad ston par go bas na/ gsungs rab thams cad gdam ngag tu 'char ba de 'byung*/ de byung na gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thams cad kyi don la thos bsam bya dgos par shes na'ang blo chung bas de dag gi don rtogs dka' bar rig ste bla ma'i man ngag dang lam rim rgyas bsdus lta bu la brten nas de rnams kyi don dka' tshegs med par rnyed par 'gyur bas na/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed pa de 'byung*/ de byung na ni rgyal ba'i bka' thams cad kyis 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs ston pa'o snyam ste/ bka' 'ga' zhig blang bya dang 'ga' zhig 'dor byar 'dzin pa'i log rtog thams cad lhag ma med par ldog nas/ chos spong gi nyes spyod chen po rang 'gags su 'gro ba de 'byung ngo*/ /de dag ji lta ba bzhin rdzogs par 'byung ba la ni/ /lam rim gyi don mthar chags su shes nas ci ltar rigs par nyams su len pa dang*/ de rgyal ba'i gsung rab 'di dang 'di nas bstan pa'i don no zhes lam rim gyi gzhung don dang rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams phan tshun sbyor shes dgos te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi la go ba rnyed pa'ang de ltar du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bslab pa gsum gyi khyad par bshad pa la gsum ste/

tshul khrims/ ting 'dzin/ shes rab kyi bslab pa'o/ /'di dag srung tshul phan yon sogs rgyas par 'dir mi 'chad kyi/ ngo bo dang dbye ba'i dka' gnas 'ga' zhig mtha' dpyod kyi sgo nas bshad par bya'o/ /de yang tshul khrims ni bslab pa gzhan gnyis kyi rtsa ba lta bu yin te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs/ /zhes bshad pa ltar/ tshul khrims la brten nas sems mnyam par 'jog pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'byung*/ de las sems rnam par grol ba'i shes rab kyi bslab pa 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /sde snod gsum bstan pa yang bslab pa gsum gyi dbang du mdzad pa yin te/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa'i sgo nas 'dul ba'i sde snod dang*/ de bzhin du lhag pa ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab kyi bslab pa gnyis gtso bor ston pa'i sgo nas rim pa bzhin du mdo sde dang*/ mngon pa'i sde snod du bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /spyi tshul khrims kyi bslab pa tsam zhig phyi rol pa'am/ de dang 'dra ba'i gang zag gzhan la'ang yod mod kyang*/ /'dir lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ste/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ nges 'byung dang*/ sangs rgyas don gnyer gyi bsam pa ci rigs pas zin na gzhan gyi bslab pa las lhag par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /der ma zad bslab pa gzhan gnyis kyang de'i rgyud la yod de/ de'i rgyud la srog gcod spong ba sogs yod pas tshul khrims yod la/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug kyang yod pas ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'ang yod cing*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab med kyang sgra dang gtan tshigs rig pa sogs shes pa yod pas shes rab kyi bslab pa yang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'dir lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa bshad pa la bsdu na gnyis te/ tshul khrims kyi ngo bor bye ba dang bcas pa dang*/

de'i 'phros don no/ /dang po ni/ spyir gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las yid phyir log pa'i spong sems ni tshul khrims yin la/ de sems bskyed bsngo ba shes rab khyad par can gsum po'am gang rung gis zin na tshul khrims kyi phar phyin du'ang 'gyur te/ spyod 'jug las/ nya la sogs pa gang zhig tu/ /de dag gsod mi 'gyur bar bskrad/ /spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las/ / tshul khrims pha rol phyin par bshad/ /ces dang*/ 'jug pa'i ṭika chen las/ sbyin pa la bshad pa des tshul khrims la sogs pa la'ang sems bskyed dang bsngo ba dang shes rab kyis zin pa so so ba dang gnyis ka rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang tshul khrims kyi phar phyin ni/ pha rol tu phyin zin pa'i dbang du byas nas sangs rgyas kyi sar yod la/ phyin par byed pa la sbyar na slob lam na'ang yod do/ /de lta na'ang tshul khrims kyi ngo bo la ni shes pas ma khyab ste/ so thar gyi tshul khrims la gzugs can yod pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye na gsum ste/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba chos sdud dang*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims so/ /dang po ni/ so thar gyi sdom ldan gyi khyim pa dang rab byung gi rgyud kyi so thar gyi sdom pa dngos dang de dag dang thun mong gi spong sdom ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims te/ lha lta bu so thar gyi rten du mi rung ba'i gang zag gi rgyud la so thar dang thun mong ba'i mi dge ba bcu sogs rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba ci rigs spong ba'i spong sdom yod pas de yang sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin no/ /de la yang kun slong dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas na mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i spong sdom bcu yod la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas lus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun spong ba'i spong ba bdun yod do/ /des na so thar gyi sdom pa ma blangs pa'i khyim pa'i rgyud la so thar gyi sdom pa dngos med kyang*/

de dag dkon mchog la skyabs su song ba'i sgo nas mi dge bcu ci rigs spong ba yod pas so thar dang thun mong ba'i tshul khrims yod cing*/ de ltar spong ba'i spong sems sa bon dang bcas pa ci rigs pa nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims dngos sam rjes su mthun pa gang rung yin la/ dkon mchog la skyabs su ma song ba'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi srog gcod spong ba'i sems pa ni sdom pa ma yin kyang*/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyi phyogs gtogs tsam tu sems so/ /des na sdom pa yin na tshul khrims yin pas khyab kyang tshul khrims yin na sdom pa yin pas ma khyab bo/ /de yang ngan song gsum dang gzugs med na chos nyid kyi thob pa'i tshul khrims yod kyang sdom pa len pa ni med la/ 'dod lha dang mi la ni chos nyid kyis thob pa dang gzhan las len pa gnyis ka yod/ byang sems kyi sdom pa khams gsum na yod kyang*/ so thar ni mi'i rten nyid la'o/ /so thar rigs brgyad gang rung gi sdom pa yin na/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin dgos kyang*/de brgyad po gang rung rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi sdom pa yin na de yin mi dgos te/ dge slong gi rgyud kyi sdom pa yin na/ dge slong gi sdom pa yin mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ dge slong gi rgyud kyi byang sems kyi sdom pa dang*/ zag med kyi sdom pa rnams dge slong gi sdom pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /byang sems kyi rgyud kyi sdom pa yin na/ byang sems kyi sdom pa yin pas kyang ma khyab ste/ byang sems kyi rgyud la dge slong gi sdom pa yod pa'i phyir te/ dge slong gi sdom pa ni so thar gyi sdom pa yin la/ byang sems kyi sdom pa zhes pa ni 'jug sdom la byed pa'i phyir ro/ /des na kha cig byang sems kyi sdom pa 'jug sdom las gzhan du sems pa ni ma go ba chen po'o/ /rten gyi sgo nas khyim pa dang rab byung gi rgyud kyi sdom pa'i tshul khrims gnyis te/

de yang dge slong pha ma gnyis dang dge tshul pha ma gnyis dang dge slob ma'i sdom pa lnga ni rab byung gi phyogs dang*/ dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis dang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa gsum ni khyim pa'i phyogs kyi sdom pa'o/ /gnyis pa dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims ni/ phyin drug la sogs pa'i dge ba rnams ci rigs par skye ba dang gnas pa dang gong 'phel du byed pa'i tshul khrims te/ de yang gsung rab la thos bsam byed pa'i skabs kyi sems pa dang*/ de bzhin du kha ton byed pa dang*/ yan lag bdun pa byed pa dang*/ bag yod bsten pa dang*/ tshogs bsog sgrib sbyong byed pa'i tshul khrims rnams yin la/ mdor na dge ba'i chos srung zhing spel bar byed pa rnams so/ /gsum pa don byed kyi tshul khrims ni/ don bya ba bcu gcig lta bu'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims te/ gzhan gyi grogs byed pa dang thabs ston pa dang phan 'dogs pa dang 'jigs pa dang mya ngan gyis gzir ba dang yo byad kyis phongs pa dang gnas 'cha' ba dang blo mthun par 'dod pa dang yang dag par zhugs pa dang log par zhugs pa dang rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dul dgos pa rnams kyi don ci rigs par sgrub par byed pa'i tshul khrims so/ /sdom pa blangs sam ma blangs kyang srog gcod sogs rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba gang spong yang de spong ba'i sems pa ni tshul khrims yin la/ 'on kyang srog gcod sogs mi byed pa tsam la ni de spong ba'i nges pa med de/ byis pa chung ngu bzhin no/ /mdor na mi dge ba bcu sogs rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba ci rigs gtso bor spong ba'i sgo nas bshag pa'i tshul khrims de/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ phyin drug lta bu dge ba'i chos gtso bor sgrub pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i tshul khrims de/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ /sems can gyi don gtso bor byed pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i tshul khrims de/

sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims so/ /de yang byed las kyi gtso bo'i dbang du byas pa ste/ mi 'gal bar sems te brtag /gnyis pa ni/ sngags kyi skabs su'ang tshul khrims de gsum la gtso bor bslab dgos pa yin te/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo sogs las/ tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bdag gis bzung*/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ / 'di rnam snang gi dam tshig dang sdom pa'i skabs su 'byung yang*/ rigs lnga ka la sbyong bar rjai nyid kyis rtsa ltung ṭika chen las bshad do/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa'i khyad par ni/ ji ltar khas blangs pa las mi 'da' bas na dam tshig dang*/ bya rgyu mi byed pa 'gog cing mi bya rgyu byed pa sdom pas na sdom pa ste/ de gnyis 'gal ba yang ma yin no/ /'o na byang sems kyis sngags sdom blang ba'i tshe/ sngar gyi tshul khrims gsum po de sngags sdom yin nam ma yin zhe na/ 'di'i lan rgyas par byas na mang du dogs pas cung zad cig brjod na/ sa skya ba'i bla chen kha cig so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi sdom pa gsum rim gyis gnas 'gyur du bzhed pa yin te/ dge slong gis byang sems kyi sdom pa thob pa'i tshe so thar de byang sems kyi sdom par 'gyur zhing*/ de nas sngags sdom thob pa'i tshe snga ma thams cad gsang sngags kyi sdom par 'gyur bar bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /rang lugs gnas 'gyur gyi tshul mi 'dod te/ sngags sdoms thob pa'i dge slong byang sems kyi rgyud la sngar gyi tshul khrims gsum so sor yod par ma zad/ so thar dang byang sems gsang sngags kyi sdom pa gsum yang ldog pa tha dad pa'i tshul gyis yod do/ /de'i phyir dge slong des sdom pa de gsum ka srung dgos pa yin te/ 'on kyang gtso gang che ba dang spyir btang dmigs bsal rnams kyang shes dgos so/ /so thar dngos sam de dang thun mong ba'i sdom pa'i khyad par ni gong du brjod pa ltar yin la/

byang sems kyi sdom pa ni 'jug sems cho gas bzung nas spyod pa la bslab par las blangs pa'i ldog cha nas 'jog cing*/ sngags sdom ni rigs lnga'i sdom bzung gi cho ga la brten nas de'i mi mthun phyogs spong bar khas blangs pa'i cha nas 'jog go /'o na/ tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /zhes sogs 'byung ba ltar blangs pa'i sngags sdom yang 'dug pas/ de ltar na so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi sdom pa gsum yang mi 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhe na/ 'di la mkhas pa kha cig sdom pa de gsum gyi gzhi mthun yod pa lta bur bzhed la/ kha cig de gsum gtong thob kyi rgyu so so ba yin pa'i phyir 'gal ba kho na'o zhes bzhed do/ /rje yab sras kyis gnas 'gyur mi bzhed kyang 'gal mi 'gal gsal bar bshad pa mi 'dug pas/ don 'di cung nges dka' bar snang ngo*/ /'on kyang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung gi skabs su skyabs 'gro dang tshul khrims gsum sogs mdo phyogs dang thun mong ba mang du 'byung bas/ de bzung ba'i tshe srog gcod spong ba sogs thun mong ba 'ga' zhig sngags kyi bsam pas zin pa'i dbang gis sngags sdom gyi yan lag tu 'gyur yang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas thun mong pa'i sdom pa nyid du 'thad par sems mod/ 'on kyang dge bsnyen sogs sdom gsum rim gyis blangs pa'i dge slong gi rgyud kyi srog gcod slong ba'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa sogs gsum po de 'gal bar 'dod pa ltar na ni/ so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi sdom pa gsum rim gyis blangs pa'i gang zag gi rgyud gyi sdom pa gsum yang 'gal bar khas len dgos par mngon te dpyad par bya'o/ /dge slong byang sems kyis sngags sdom thob pa'i tshe/ de'i rgyud kyi tshul khrims gsum po de/ byang sems kyi tshul khrims yin kyang*/ byang sems kyi sdom pa yin mi dgos te/ de gnyis 'jog tshul gyi don mi 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi sdom pa gsum po rdzas tha dad du bzhed pa'i lugs snang mod de ltar 'dod mi 'dod ci ltar yang*/

ldog pa tha dad du nges par khas len dgos te/ bsnyen gnas ma gtogs so thar rigs bdun dngos gnas pa rnams ni ji srid 'tsho bar gyi mtha' can gyi rigs gnas dang*/ byang sems dang sngags sdom ni byang chub kyi snying po'i mtha' can gyi rigs gnas yin yang sngags sdom lta bu sngags la zhugs pa'i skabs der yod par 'jog dgos kyi/ de yin na skye ba thams cad du 'jug par nges pas ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ khyab na tshe 'di sngags pa yin pa de skye ba phyi ma thams cad du'ang sngags par thal bar 'gyur snyam ste dpyad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa la gnyis te/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dmigs pa las gzhan du mi g.yeng ba'i sems rtse gcig pa'i sems pa ste/ rgyun ring thung gang yin kyang dge ba'i dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pa tsam gyis ni bsam gtan nam ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang sngags rim chen mo las/ dge ba'i sems rtse gcig pa cig byung na yun ring thung gang yin yang ting nge 'dzin yod pa yin pas/ ting nge 'dzin tsam zhig mi 'grub par 'dod pa mi rigs la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ yul nges lnga'i nang tshan du'ang ting nge 'dzin 'byung bas ting nge 'dzin tsam dang zhi gnas kyi khyad par phyed par bya'o/ /'o na rang re tsho'i rgyud la'ang ting nge 'dzin yod par 'gyur ro zhe na/ bsam gtan gzugs med kyis bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin dka' yang*/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa'i rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin yod de/ yul nges lnga'i nang tshan gyi ting nge 'dzin yod pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dang de gnyis ka'i phyogs kyi sgo nas gsum dang*/ byed las kyi sgo nas lus sems bde bar gnas pa dang*/ yon tan bsgrub pa dang*/ sems can don byed kyi bsam gtan te gsum mo/ /de'i dang po ni/ lus sems shin sbyangs kyi bde bas zin pa'i bsam gtan/

gnyis pa ni/ mngon shes sogs sgrub par byed pa'i bsam gtan dang*/ gsum pa ni/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i bsam gtan no/ /yum gyi mdo las ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam grangs mang po dang*/ khyad par nyan rang gi yid byed dang bral ba'i sgo nas rdzogs byang 'dod pa'i dge sems rtse gcig pa thams cad la ni bsam gtan du bshad do/ /'dir go bde bar byas na/ bla ma dang dkon mchog dang las 'bras la yid rtse gcig pa'i dad pa dang lhan cig 'jug pa'i dge sems dang*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa lta bu dran pa'i yid rtse gcig pa dang*/ gsung rab kyi don de dang de la de'o snyam pa'i yid rtse gcig pa dang*/ stong nyid dang lha sku sogs sgom par byed pa'i yid rtse gcig pa rnams kyang bsam gtan gyi phyogs so/ /da lta'i gang zag gi rgyud la zhi gnas dang lhag mthong skye dka' yang*/ dge ba'i dmigs pa las ma g.yengs pa'i sems rtse gcig pa thams cad ni zhi gnas kyi phyogs dang*/ gsung rab kyi tshig don yang dag par dpyod pa'i shes rab rnams ni lhag mthong gi phyogs su 'du ba yin te/ lam rim las/ ma g.yengs pa'i sems ni zhi gnas kyi phyogs sems rtse gcig pa yin la/ don dang chos yang dag par sems pa ni lhag mthong gi phyogs so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab bo/ /zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ dge ba'i dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig pa yan chad kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams ni zhi gnas kyi phyogs su 'du la/ ji lta ba'am ji snyed pa'i don so sor 'byed pa'i shes rab rnams lhag mthong gi phyogs su 'du bas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na rang la'ang ting nge 'dzin gang yod med kyi khyad par phyed par bya yi/ dbye ba med par thams cad gcig tu 'khrul par mi bya'o/ /'o na/ mi dge ba'i dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'i blo yod pas de ting nge 'dzin du mi 'gyur ram zhe na/

mi 'gyur te/ shes rab nyon mongs can de shes rab ma yin pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa shes rab kyi bslab pa la gnyis te/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ btags pa'i dngos po la chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa ni shes rab kyi ngo bo yin la/ dbye na gsum ste/ don dam rtogs pa dang*/ kun rdzob rtogs pa dang*/ sems can don byed kyi shes rab bo/ /dang po la ni/ bdag med phra mo don spyi'i sgo nas rtogs pa dang mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyis so/ /der ma zad bdag med rags pa rtogs pa'ang 'di'i phyogs su gtogs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bzo dang gso ba dang sgra dang gtan tshigs dang nang rigs pa ste rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i shes rab rnams te/ 'phags pa byams pas mdo sde rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ / 'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar gcad rjes bzung dang*/ /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson bya/ /zhes dang*/ thogs med kyis byang sa las kyang*/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa gang yin pa rig pa'i gnas lnga po nang rig pa dang gtan tshigs rig pa dang gso ba rig pa dang sgra rig pa dang bzo dang las kyi gnas kyi rig pa la dmigs pas 'jug pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi ngo bo nyid yin pa rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ lam rim las kyang*/ skabs 'dir ni rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa la sogs pa'i shes rab ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'o na/ phyi rol pa'ang rig gnas dang po bzhi yod pas lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa yod par mi 'gyur ram snyam na/ de dag la de rnams yod pas shes rab kyi bslab pa yod kyang*/ skyabs 'gro rnam dag dang thar pa don gnyer gyi bsam pa med pas lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ni med do/ /des na spyir rig gnas dang po bzhi tsam shes pa'i shes rab rnams ni/

sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs khyad par can min kyang*/ skyabs 'gro dang nges 'byung dang snying rje chen po dang sems bskyed dang rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i bsngo ba khyad par can gyis zin na ni/ de thams cad kyang sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur te/ dper na/ spyir zas sbyin pa tsam zhig ni/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs min kyang*/ rnam mkhyen don gnyer gyi bsam pas zin pa'i sgo nas gzhan la zas sbyin pa ni sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /des na bsam pa khyad par can gyis zin phyin chad ci tsam thos pa mang ba dang gsung rab kyi don rtogs pa'i shes rab mang ba de tsam du lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa yang mang bar rtogs te/ dper na/ ji tsam bsrung ba'i tshul khrims mang na de'i bslab pa dang*/ ci tsam mi g.yeng ba'i sems mang na ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'ang mang du 'byung ba bzhin no/ /shes rab kyi bslab pa thams cad kyi gtso bo ni bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa spyi dang lhag mthong ste/ snga ma la bdag med rtogs pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum yod do/ /de'i phyir bdag med pa'i don sgom pa lta ci/ thos bsam tsam zhig byed pa'ang don che'o/ /gsum pa sems can gyi don byed pa'i shes rab ni/ sems can gyi don bsgrub tshul legs par shes pa'o/ /de ltar rang la shes rab kyi bslab pa gang yod pa dang med pa'i khyad par yang byed par bya'o/ /gsum pa thos bsam sgom gsum gyi khyad par bshad pa la gnyis/ de'i go rim dang*/ khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ byams mgon gyis mdo sde'i rgyan las/ 'di na dang por thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'ang 'byung*/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa goms las yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdzaud las/ thos sogs las byung blo rnams ni/ /ming dang gnyis ga don yul can/

/zhes thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab gsum ni rim pa bzhin du gsung rab kyi tshig dang don gnyis ka dang don rkyang la dmigs pa'i sgo nas 'jog par bshad kyang*/ rang lugs ni/ lam rim chen mo las/ des na gang nyams su blangs rgyu de dang por gzhan las nyan nas gzhan stobs kyis nges par byed/ des nas thob pa'i don de rang gis lung dang rigs pas tshul bzhin du bsams te ngang stobs kyis nges par byed/ de ltar thos bsam gyis nges par byas te the tshom dang bral ba na yang dang yang du 'dris par byed pa la bsgom pa zhes zer bas/ yang yang dpyad gyin bsgom pa dang mi dpyod pa'i 'jog sgom gnyis ka dgos te/ thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa de la mi dpyod par 'jog pa dang so sor rtog pas dpyad nas bsgom pa gnyis ka snang ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhung gang yin pa de dang por gzhan la nyan nas thos pa ni thos pa tsam yin la/ nyan pa ltar don de legs par go ba'i shes rab ni/ thos byung gi shes rab ste/ de ni gzhan stobs kyis skye'o/ /de nas sngar thos pa'i stobs kyis go ba'i don de rang gis lung dang rigs pas legs par dpyod pa ni bsam pa yin la/ dpyad pa ltar nges pa'i shes rab skyes pa ni/ bsam byung gi shes rab ste/ de ni rang stobs kyis skye'o/ /de ltar thos bsam gyis nges par byas pa'i don de blo la yang yang 'dris par byed pa ni sgom pa ste/ de la dpyad sgom dang 'jog sgom gnyis yod do/ /de ltar yang yang 'dris par byas pa'i sgom pa la brten nas ni bsgoms byung gi shes rab skye ste/ lam rim las/ de yang thos byung gi sngon du thos pa dang bsam byung gi sngon du bsam pa 'gro dgos pa ltar bsgom byung gi sngon du'ang bsgom pa bgrod dgos te/ shes rab de ni bsgom pa las byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar byas na bsgom byung gishes rab kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i bsgom pa de bsam byung gi shes rab kyis nges par byed pa de nyid goms pa yin pas bsam byung gi shes rab las bsgoms byung gi shes rab 'byung bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/

/zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar thos bsam bsgom gsum dang*/ de las byung pa'i shes rab gsum po tshad ma gang yin gyi byed par yang legs par shes dgos te/ mkhas grub rin po ches sde bdun mun sel las/ go 'phangs mchog 'tshol bdag gis ni/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang bsgoms pa las byung ba'i shes rab gsum lam gyi lus su ma byas par thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa gang yang thob par mi nus pas/ shes rab gsum po de'i rang bzhin la brtag pa bya dgos la/ shes rab gsum po de dag gi rang bzhin ni 'di ltar/ bsgoms pa las byung ba'i shes rab gang yin rtags la brten nas skyes pas ma khyab kyi/ myong stobs kyis sgro 'dogs kyi sa bon 'joms par byed nus pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum yang yod la/ shes rab gzhan gnyis ni rtags la brten nas skyes pas khyab cing*/ 'on kyang tshad ma dang des drangs pa'i dpyad shes kyi ngo bo gnyis su yod de/ /de la thos byung gi shes rab ni/ gang zag gzhan gyi ngag thos pa'i stobs kyis tshul gsum la dran pa skyes pa'i rtags la brten nas skyes pas khyab pa'i phyir thos byung gi shes rab skyed pa'i rtags yang dag la gzhan don gyi rtags yang dag ces bya'o/ /bsam byung gi shes rab ni/ gang zag gzhan gyis bstan pa la ma bltos par rang nyid kyis tshul bzhin bsams pa'i stobs kyis rnyed pa'i sgrub byed yang dag la brten nas dpag par bya ba'i don rtogs pa'i rjes dpag dang*/ des drangs pa'i dpyad shes kyi ngo bo gnyis su nges pa yin la/ de'i phyir bsam byung gi shes rab kyi rten du gyur pa'i rtags yang dag ni rang don gyi rtags yang dag ces bya'o/ /des na thos byung gi shes rab ces pa sgrub byed yang dag la ma bltos par gzhan gyi tshig thos pa tsam las/ don rtogs pa'i blo la 'dod pa dag ni/ gzhal bya rtogs pa tshad ma la rag ma las par tshig tsam gyis blang dor khong du chud par 'dod pa yin pas yang dag pa'i shes pa'i dgra bo mi bzad pa yin mod kyang*/

ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gzhan la gzhung gi tshig thos kyang don ma go ba'i thos pa tsam ni thos bsam gnyis su phye ba'i thos pa mtshan nyid tshang ba yin te/ de'i gnyis su phye ba'i thos pa yang dag la ni thos pa'i don de rags tsam zhig yin yang legs par go dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na thos bsam sgom gsum 'gal lam zhe na/ thos bsam sgom gsum rim par skye ba'i dbang du byas na 'gal yang*/ spyir thos bsam gnyis mi 'gal te/ don de gzhan las thos nas de stobs kyis thog mar nges pa de/ thos pa gtso che yang bsam pa tsam zhig kyang yin pa'i phyir te/ ma bsams na ni mi nges pa'i phyir ro/ /bsam sgom gnyis kyang mi 'gal te/ bsgoms pa rnams bsam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ ma bsams na ni bsgom pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /thos bsam gnyis gong du bshad pa des shes par bya zhing*/ sgom zhes pa la yang yang dpyad na sgom pa dang mi dpyod par 'jog pa'i 'jog sgom gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni/ lam rim las/ de ltar na dad pa bsgom pa dang tshad med bzhi dang byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang bde ba dang ldan pa dang sdug bsngal bsgom pa zhes gsungs pa lta bu yang dang yang du dpyad nas skyong dgos pa la sgom du gsungs pa mtha' yas pa zhig snang ste/ zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ bshes gnyen la dad pa bsgom pa dang dal 'byor don che zhing rnyed dka' ba dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang las rgyus 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa lta bu la ni dpyad sgom dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ 'jog sgom la ni dmigs pa la yang yang mi dpyod par rtse gcig tu gnas pas zhi gnas bsgrub pa'i skabs lta bu ste de la ni 'jog sgom dgos so/ /gzhan yang lam rim las/ des na thos bsam gyi shes rab kyi nges pa de nyid la 'dris par byed pa tsam de bsgoms byung ma yin mod kyang bsgom pa yin pa ci zhig 'gal zhes dang*/

sgom zhes grags pa sems dge ba'i dmigs pa la yang dang yang du gtong ba'i dmigs rnam skyong ba 'di zhes dang*/ des na sgom zhes pa ni phar phyin gyi 'grel bshad tshig gsal las/ sgom par byed pa zhes bya ba ni yid de'i skal ba can du byed pa'am/ de'i dngos por byed pa'o zhes bshad pa ltar go bar bya ste/ dper na/ dad pa sgom snying rje sgom zhes pa ni yid de dang der bskyed pa la bya dgos pa bzhin no/ /de'i phyir lo ts+tsha ba chen po rnams kyis kyang res 'ga' sgom pa'i lam zhes par bsgyur la/ res 'ga' ni mngon rtogs rgyan las/ mthong dang goms pa'i lam dag la/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar goms par 'gyur te bsgom pa dang goms pa gnyis don gcig go /zhes gsungs pa ltar spyir sgom zhes pa de ci 'dra zhig la byed shes par bya ste/ thos bsam gyi don la rigs pas yang yang dpyod cing 'dris par byed pa la dpyad sgom dang*/ de ltar mi dpyod par yid rtse gcig tu gnas pa la 'jog sgom du bshad pa'i phyir ro/ / de ltar mi phyed par sgom thams cad rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i 'jog sgom du 'dod pa ni cher 'khrul te/ lam rim las/ des na sgom thams cad 'jog sgom du 'dod pa ni dper na nas rdog gcig bzung nas 'bru thams cad 'di kho na yin no zhes zer ba dang 'dra ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /byed shes na thos bsam mang nyung gi dbang gis sgom pa'ang mang nyung du 'gyur te/ lam rim chen mo las/ thos pa ci tsam mang ba de tsam du de las byung ba'i shes rab mang la/ de mang ba tsam du bsam pa mang ba dang de mang ba tsam du de las byung ba'i shes rab mang ba dang*/ de ci tsam mang ba bzhin du sgom pas nyams su len pa mang la/ de la ngan skyon 'gog pa dang yon tan sgrub pa'i tshul yang mang bas/ sgom byed pa la thos bsam gal che bar gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa nas gsungs pa yin gyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/

/dpyad sgom dang 'jog sgom gyi khyad par sngar ltar yin na/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom pa tsam la dpyad sgom dang 'jog sgom gnyis ka 'ong ngam mi 'ong zhe na/ 'ong ste/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i tshul lung dang rigs pas yang yang dpyod pa tsam byed cing sems pa'i tshe dpyad sgom gtso che yang*/ dpyad mthar des na 'chi ba mi rtag pa nyid do zhes rtse gcig tu sems pa la 'jog sgom gtso che ste/ bla ma dang dkon mchog dang las 'bras la dad pa dang ngan song dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sems pa dang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang lha sku sgom pa lta bu la'ang tshul de gnyis su go bar bya'o/ /gal te zag bcas kyi yul la sred pas yang yang dpyod pa dang rtse gcig tu sems pa'ang yod pas/ de dag la dpyad sgom dang 'jig sgom yod par 'gyur zhe na/ skyon med de/ 'dir yang dag pa'i don thos nas bsam zhing 'dris par byed pa la thos bsam sgom pa'i tha snyad byed pa yin gyi/ phyin ci log gi mthong thos nas 'dres pa yod kyang de dag la thos bsam sgom pa'i tha snyad mi byed pa'i phyir te/ dper na/ rkang pa 'degs 'jog gi gzhir lam zhes 'jig rten na grags kyang 'dir de lam du mi 'dod pa bzhin no/ /gal te 'dod na/ sems can thams cad kyang lam zhugs su thal ba 'gyur ro/ /rten gyi dbang du byas na tshogs lam man chad la gnas pa'i so skye'i rgyud la thos bsam gyi shes rab mang la/ slob pa 'phags pa la thos bsam yod kyang bsgom byung gi shes rab gtso che zhing*/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud la ni bsgom byung gi shes rab yod kyi/ thos byung dang bsam byung gi shes rab gnyis med de/ de gzhan gyis bstan pa la rag las pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na rab tu byung ba rnams kyi bya ba'i gtso bo ni/ lung rtogs gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum ste/ mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/

/lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ni lung rtogs kyi bstan pa gnyis yod kyi/ gzhan med la/ de yang lung gi bstan pa la thos bsam gtso bor byed cing*/ rtogs pa'i bstan pa bsgom pas nyams su len pa gtso bor byed dgos te/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa gnyis ngo bo'i sgo nas 'dzin tshul yang de ltar ro/ /lung dang rtog pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par ni/ spyir gsung rab kyi gzhung rnams ci ltar rig pa thos nas rang stobs sam gzhan stobs kyi de'i don legs par go ba yod na ni lung gi yon tan yod pa yin la/ go ba ltar nyams su len pa yod na ni rtogs pa'i yon tan yod ces bya'o/ /de yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang bslab pa gsum phar phyin drug rim gnyis kyi nyams len rnams ni rtogs pa'i yon tan bsdus pa yin la/ khyad par byang chub kyi sems dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab lta bu ni rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi gtso bo yin no/ /mngon shes mtshan nyid pa ni rtogs pa'i yon tan mchog yin kyang*/ kha cig sngar bshad pa ltar mi shes par rang gi tshod kyang mi thing ba'i lung bstan thar thor smra ba tsam dang blun sgom byed pa tsam la rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi mchog yod par nges par snyam pa ni dbang po rtul por gsal lo/ /gal te lam rim dang bskyed rdzogs kyi 'chad nyan lta bu la thos bsam sgom gsum yod pa 'thad kyang*/ mtshan nyid kyi 'chad nyan la de gsum ka yod dam med ce na/ yod de/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod bzhi'i 'chad nyan la de gsum yod pa ni gzhir bcas mod/ bsdus grwa'i 'chad nyan tsam la'ang de gsum yod pa'i phyir te/ de la thos bsam yod pa la rtsod pa med mod/ sgom pa'ang yod pa'i phyir te/ bsdus gzhung 'di rgyal ba'i gsung rab spyi dang de'i dgongs 'grel tshad ma sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa nas 'byung ba'i don tshan bsdus nas ston pa yin la/

'di'i don rtag mi rtag dang rgyu 'bras dang 'gal 'brel sogs gzhan las thos nas gzhan stobs kyis nges pa yod pas thos pa tshad ldan yod la/ de nas rang gi lung dang rigs pas dpyad nas legs par nges pa yod pas bsam pa yod cing*/ de ltar thos bsam byas pa'i don de la blo yang yang 'dris nas goms pa yod pas dpyad sgom kyang yod pa'i phyir te/ dper na/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang las 'bras la dpyad nas skyong ba la dpyad sgom du bshad pa bzhin no/ /des na mtshan nyid skor gyi gzhung sogs nang rig pa ston pa'i gsung rab kyi gzhung thams cad kyang thos bsam gyi gzhung yin par ma zad/ rang gis ma shes pa ma gtogs nyams len gyi gzhung kyang yin te/ bshad sgrub gnyis sam thos bsam dang*/ nyams len gyi gzhung gnyis so sor ris su gcod pa ma rigs pa'i phyir te/ lam rim chen mo las dam pa'i chos la bshad pa dang bsgrub pa'i chos logs logs pa gnyis yod par 'dzin pa ni/ dri ma med pa'i mdo rgyud dang dri ma med pa'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos la gus pa chen po skye ba'i gegs byed cing*/ de dag la nang gi don mi ston pa'i phyi'i go rgya gcod pa'o zhes rnyes pa'i gnas su 'dzin pa ni chos spong ba'i las kyi sgrib pa gsog pa shes par bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ rgyal tshab rin po ches phar phyin gyi skabs bzhi pa'i rnam bshad las/ thos bsam byed pa dang nyams len byed pa'i gzhung tshad la mi 'dra ba so sor gcod pa ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams par byed pa'i tshig yin pas dor bar rig pa kho na'o/ /zhes dang*/ thos bsam dang nyams len gyi gzhung so sor gcod pa gzhung chen po rnams nub pa'i rkyen byed pas rna bar mi 'ong ba'i tshig tu shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang thos bsam kun gyi don nyams len byed shes pa ni ches dkon par bshad do/ /bsgom pas nyams su len pa dang shes rab 'phel ba la'ang thos bsam gal che ste/

lam rim las/ de ltar chos tshul bzhin bsgrub par 'dod pa rnams la lam gyi srog dam pa chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab bskyed pa'i rgyud bla na med pa dri ma med pa'i gsung rab dang bstan bcos la mang du thos pa dgos so/ /zhes dang*/ sngags rim las kyang*/ rang gis sgrub pa dang gzhan la ston pa sogs gang byed kyang thog mar thos bsam gyis go ba ma nor ba cig btsal dgos te/ rang gis mi shes na gzhan la ston mi nus pa'i phyir dang*/ ma shes par nyams su blangs pa med pa'i phyir dang*/ rang gis ci tsam zhig go ba de bzhin du nyams su len pas go ba nor na sgrub pa nor la/ sgrub pa ma nor ba yang go ba ma nor ba la rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa la phan yon rgya cher bshad du yod mod/ 'dir thos pa'i phan yon gtso bor brjod na/ tshoms las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ thos pas sdig las ldog par byed/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spong*/ /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa 'thob/ /zhes dang*/ mig ldan mar me yod pa yis/ /gzugs rnams mthong ba ji lta bar/ /de bzhin dge dang sdig pa'i chos/ /thos pas rnam par shes par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ skyes rabs las kyang*/ gang zhig thos pas yid ni dad gyur nas/ / legs par dga' la brtan pa nyid du 'gyur/ /shes rab skye zhing gti mug med par 'gyur/ /rang gi shes kyang de ni nyo ba'i rigs/ /thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/ /zhes dang*/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ thos nyung dmus long bsgom pa'i tshul mi shes/ de med des ko ci zhig bsam par bya/ /de bas thos la brtson bya de rgyu las/ /bsams bzhin bsgoms pas shes rab yangs pa 'byung*/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na sangs rgyas kyang thos bsam bsgoms pa las 'byung na gzhan lta ci smos/ thos pa sgom gsum zhes/ thams cad la rlung ltar grags na'ang*/ ming tsam zhig ma gtogs de'i khyad par rje yab sras kyi bzhed pa bzhin legs par shes pa ni dkon par snang bas/

'dir de ltar shes pa'i ched du de gsum gyi khyad par gzhung chen po nas 'byung ba'i tshul rang gi go tshod tsam zhig brjod pa ste/ rnam dpyod can gyis da dung legs par dpyad par 'tshal lo/ /smras pa/ gsung rab dgongs 'grel bcas pa du ma las/ /skyes bu gsum dang bslab gsum thos bsam sogs/ /bshad pa'i dka' ba'i gnas la mtha' dpyod kyis/ /legs par brgyan te mkhas pa'i dgongs bzhin bshad/ ces pa 'di'ang shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub kyis gzhan 'ga' la phan 'dod kyi 'dun pas co ne dgon nyid du sbyar ba ste/ 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la phan par gyur cig/shu baṃ/ sarba maṅgalaṃ/
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/skyes bu gsum dang bslab pa gsum dang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi dka' gnas snying po bzhugs/ -PAGE 34--PAGE 35--PAGE 9-
